anomalies.description: The rear windshield of the Land Rover is shattered by impact from a vehicle approaching from behind (a green sedan visible in f1).
A multi-vehicle collision occurs: a red truck collides with a white car, which is simultaneously struck by a beige tow truck; debris and spray are visible.
A red truck collides with a white sedan and a beige tow truck on a bridge, causing the sedan to be crushed and the red truck to flip onto its side.

A grey Land Rover Defender is shown driving away immediately after the crash, with visible damage including shattered side windows and a cracked windshield, indicating it was involved in or directly affected by the prior collision.

The driver of the damaged Land Rover (a woman) is seen inside the vehicle with broken windshield and side window, actively steering while looking back—consistent with evading or reacting to the recent crash.; A man on a motorcycle (with 'POLICE' visible on his jacket) rides past the accident scene amid traffic; smoke/dust is still visible in the background, confirming the recency of the crash.
